what: Quit timing: 10 quits from the title and 10 from Play (New game on the built-in world, walked into chunk (1, 0)), mixing SIGTERM to the Electron pid, Browser.close on the page target and Browser.close on the browser target; first on origin/main 12c29e7 (before), then on the same commit plus the fix (after). Plus two checks that closing the last window keeps the app on macOS (closethen).

env.QUIT_VITE_PORT: 5341 before, 5343 after (the snapshot's electron.vite.config.ts takes it; strictPort)

snapshot: git archive 12c29e7 | tar -x; node_modules, .env and native/afm-bridge/.build symlinked from the repo; electron.vite.config.ts renderer gets cacheDir .vite-cache-<name> and server {port: QUIT_VITE_PORT, strictPort: true}. after = the same plus src/main/{quit,index,handle,context}.ts from this change.
model: openai gpt-5.4-mini from .env (the built-in world writes chapter 1 and witnesses the chunks walked into; nothing else calls a model)
replay: bun docs/e2e/milestone-rev6-quit/quitloop.ts.txt <snapshotDir> <label> "<plan>"  (copy to a .ts file first; it drives scripts/cdp-drive.ts with the actions below)

methods.page: Browser.close sent on the page target's WebSocket
methods.browser: Browser.close sent on the browser target (GET /json/version)
methods.closethen: Runtime.evaluate window.close() on the page; after 3 s check the process is alive with 0 pages; then SIGTERM (timed)
methods.appQuit: no dev hook calls app.quit() in this app; not run. SIGTERM, Cmd-Q and DevTools Browser.close all reach Electron's native Browser::Quit, the same function app.quit() calls

measured: request → Electron pid gone (polled every 25 ms); if still alive after 20 s: hung, then a second SIGTERM (timed), then SIGKILL. After exit: the main log's [world] visit line and [quit] lines, save.json position vs the position read right before the quit, usage.jsonl outcomes
